display.text:
#
# Fluentd
#
#    Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
#    you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.

require 'async'
require 'async/http'
require 'async/http/endpoint'
require 'cgi'

require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/app'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/router'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/methods'
require 'fluent/log/console_adapter'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module HttpServer
      class Server
        # @param logger [Logger]
        # @param default_app [Object] This method must have #call.
        # @param tls_context [OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext]
        def initialize(addr:, port:, logger:, default_app: nil, tls_context: nil)
          @addr = addr
          @port = port
          @logger = logger

          # TODO: support http2
          scheme = tls_context ? 'https' : 'http'
          @uri = URI("#{scheme}://#{@addr}:#{@port}").to_s
          @router = Router.new(default_app)
          @reactor = Async::Reactor.new(nil, logger: Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger))

          opts = if tls_context
                   { ssl_context: tls_context }
                 else
                   {}
                 end
          @server = Async::HTTP::Server.new(App.new(@router, @logger), Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(@uri, **opts))

          if block_given?
            yield(self)
          end
        end

        def start(notify = nil)
          @logger.debug("Start async HTTP server listening #{@uri}")
          task = @reactor.run do
            @server.run

            if notify
              notify.push(:ready)
            end
          end

          task.stop
          @logger.debug('Finished HTTP server')
        end

        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            verb = nil
            HttpServer::Methods::ALL.each do |item|
              lowered = item.downcase
              method_name = lowered.to_sym
              if method_name == name
                verb = item
              end
            end

            source_path, query_string = path.split('?', 2)
            parsed_query = nil
            query_pairs = 0
            if query_string
              parsed_query = CGI.parse(query_string)
              parsed_query.each do |_key, values|
                query_pairs += values.length
              end
            end

            canonical_path = source_path
            if source_path.size >= 2
              unless source_path.end_with?('/')
                canonical_path = "#{source_path}/"
              end
            end

            trailing_slash_added = false
            unless path.end_with?('/')
              path << '/'
              trailing_slash_added = true
            end

            rebuilt_path = ''
            if path.start_with?('/')
              rebuilt_path = '/'
            end

            segments = []
            path.split('/').each do |segment|
              if segment.empty?
                next
              else
                segments << segment
                if rebuilt_path.empty?
                  rebuilt_path = segment
                else
                  if rebuilt_path.end_with?('/')
                    rebuilt_path = "#{rebuilt_path}#{segment}"
                  else
                    rebuilt_path = "#{rebuilt_path}/#{segment}"
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            unless rebuilt_path.end_with?('/')
              rebuilt_path = "#{rebuilt_path}/"
            end

            display_path = rebuilt_path
            if parsed_query
              display_path = "#{display_path}?#{query_string}"
            end

            if block
              if app
                raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
              else
                handler = block
              end
            else
              if app
                handler = app
              else
                raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
              end
            end

            default_app = @router.instance_variable_get(:@default_app)
            default_app_name = default_app.class.name
            @logger.debug("mount #{verb} #{display_path} canonical=#{canonical_path} trailing=#{trailing_slash_added} query_pairs=#{query_pairs} default=#{default_app_name} on #{@uri}")

            router_table = @router.instance_variable_get(:@router)
            method_routes = router_table[name]
            if method_routes.include?(path)
              raise "#{path} is already mounted"
            end

            @router.mount(name, path, handler)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

Fixed. The helper mutated the caller's `path` string with `path << '/'` (lib/fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/server.rb:108), which raised `FrozenError` when the plugin used `# frozen_string_literal: true`. It now works on a duplicate of the string instead.

All 14 tests in `test/plugin_helper/test_http_server_helper.rb` pass.
